backend/main.mo: Motoko actor handling contact submissions and user profiles with access control, storing submissions by email and profiles by caller principal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three search-related features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend files including routing, components, content types, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode variables, and global border/background/text styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx with viewport and title metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all site routes, including the new /search route, and renders RouterProvider.
frontend/src/components/content/FormStat: UI banner component showing success or error messages with matching colors and icons.
frontend/src/components/content/UpdateCa: Displays an update item with category badge, date, title, excerpt, and navigation to its detail page.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer with about text, quick links, state navigation buttons, and legal links plus dynamic copyright.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Top-level layout with header, optional breadcrumbs, page outlet, and footer.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Generates breadcrumb navigation links from the current URL path and renders them with icons.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Mobil: Implements a slide-out mobile navigation menu with search, main links, state links, and footer links.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Renders the site header with logo, desktop nav links, search button, and mobile menu integration.
frontend/src/content/seedUpdates.ts: Provides seeded update items containing news, metadata, and HTML content for display.
frontend/src/content/updateTypes.ts: Defines update categories, item structure, and a helper for mapping categories to display labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a mutation hook for submitting the contact form via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode settings, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, services, commitments, and contact info, while setting SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/AdmitCardsPage.tsx: Displays a list of admit card updates using UpdateCard and sets SEO metadata for the admit cards section.
Shows competitive exam categories and updates with icons and descriptions, using SEO metadata and UpdateCard components.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, submission handling, status banners, and SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Provides the site disclaimer with sections on accuracy, affiliation, verification, and liability, along with SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/EducationNewsPage.tsx: Lists education news updates via UpdateCard and sets SEO metadata, with fallback UI when no updates exist.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Serves as the main landing page with category links, latest updates, and SEO metadata for the portal.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Renders a styled 404 page with meta tags, offering navigation back home or to the previous page.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed content for a specific update post, including metadata, category, date, and fallback when not found.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Provides the full privacy policy text with structured sections and sets corresponding page metadata.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx: Shows all result-related updates using UpdateCard components and sets metadata for the results section.
frontend/src/pages/SchemesPage.tsx: Lists government scheme updates by category with page metadata and a fallback when none exist.
frontend/src/pages/ScholarshipsPage.tsx: Displays scholarship updates with state-based filters and includes an informational guide when viewing all scholarships.
frontend/src/pages/SchoolEducationPage.t: Presents school education information and related updates with sections on boards, exams, and resources.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Implements a searchable updates page with URL-synced query, memoized results, and empty/no-results states using UpdateCard components.
frontend/src/pages/StatePage.tsx: Displays state-specific updates with metadata, category links, and a grid of UpdateCards based on the stateSlug param.
frontend/src/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Custom hook that updates document title and meta description tags when page metadata changes.
frontend/src/utils/searchUpdates.ts: Provides text-based search utilities for updates, including normalization, matching, and date-sorted search results.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL or session-based parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending theme colors, layout, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing site scope, requirements, architecture notes, known issues, and implemented features.
